decisions.reason: As a renamed and apparently already well-accepted trommel screen, it is above aspiration and an established German machinery firm would almost certainly retain it.
A dedicated page and several models signal strategic commitment, and with no clear evidence of underperformance the firm would use its slack to continue the line.
Website mention without stronger promotion suggests more uncertainty, but in the first year management would usually keep a new grinder line unless results clearly fell below aspiration.
The product seems newer and more niche, yet it fits the firm's shift toward resource-saving stationary solutions so boundedly rational management would likely give it more time.
This green-waste grinder may face some overlap risk within the portfolio, but absent clear failure an experienced machinery producer would more likely continue than withdraw it quickly.
Its own page and multi-model line indicate organizational commitment, and the product matches the firm's core shredding and stationary-processing capabilities well enough to stay on the market.
